metadata.description:
In his quest to reach a remote tribal village, Shyam Sunder lost his way deep inside the jungle. With no clear paths and only instinct to guide him, it took time and persistence to finally find the right route.
When he eventually reached the village, the struggle faded away. What awaited him was an experience rooted in tradition, warmth, and indigenous wisdom. The family of Etwa Munda welcomed him into their home and prepared a special recipe of Desi Chicken (country chicken), cooked using age-old tribal methods passed down through generations.
Every bite told a story — of the forest, of survival, and of a food culture that values nature, nutrition, and community. The long journey through the jungle proved to be more than worth it.
